about: How a Codex turn that ended on an error is handled. A rule matches the task_complete record's error (codex_error_info, HTTP status, message text); the first matching rule names the class, and the class names the recovery. Add a rule when a new error shape is seen; change a class's recovery to change what every consumer does. Read by packages/codex-rollout (Classify) and by anything else that reads this file.

classes.meaning: The connection to the model dropped mid-turn; the session, its work and its goal are intact.
The provider had no capacity for the model; the same model usually answers again later.
The model's reply hit its output limit; a fresh turn carries on from the transcript.
The provider refused the session's model or account setup; resuming repeats the refusal.
The provider flagged the content; someone decides whether to rescope, rephrase or stop.
No rule matches this error yet; someone reads it, decides, and adds a rule here.
